meta.name: Not Just a Game
meta.description: We’ve been told again and again that sports and politics don’t mix, that games are just games and athletes should just “shut up and play.” ButNot Just a Gameargues that far from providing merely escapist entertainment, American sports have long been at the centre of some of the major political debates and struggles of our time. By tracing the good, the bad, and the ugly of American sports culture,Not Just a Gameshows how American sports have glamorised militarism, racism, sexism, and homophobia; but also traces a largely forgotten history of rebel athletes who stood up to power and fought for social justice beyond the field of play.
